task.title: Add week labels to the export
task.goal: The CSV export gets a 'week' column with the ISO week label of each order's date.

verifier.focus: The change fits the existing code.

report:
Added the 'week' column to export.py. The label comes from the new helper
weeks.py (week_label), which formats the ISO year and week as 2026-W07.
Tested by hand on a few dates; output matches.
